auteur.cursus: A former student of the economics and management preparatory classes (CPGE D2) in Strasbourg, I am in the final year of a degree in economics and international relations, on exchange at the Université de Montréal (2026-2027).
auteur.texte.0: Prépa and my degree gave me knowledge and a way of thinking. Yet I have always found it hard to grasp what is really at stake in the news. So I wanted to create an app that brings together information and avenues for reflection on geopolitics, economics and finance.
auteur.texte.1: With a commitment to scientific rigour: being rational and starting from the facts, not only those that make the headlines, but also those that are rarely covered.
